Bathroom Remodeling in Clearwater, KS

Clearwater is south Sedgwick County's small established community near the Ninnescah River. The homes here range from mid-20th century rural construction to more recent builds, with the older stock dominating. These are practical homes built for working households — and their bathrooms reflect that: functional in the basic sense, dated in every other sense, and ready for renovation that most of them have never seen.

The challenge with Clearwater bathrooms isn't dramatic — it's the accumulation of small compromises. The original 1960s ceramic tile that can't be cleaned to look good anymore. The fiberglass surround that was a step up in 1985 and has been declining since. The exhaust fan that hums and barely moves air. The vanity that's been painted twice and should have been replaced.

Wheatland Construction serves Clearwater and south Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

Clearwater Bathroom Remodeling Specifics

Ninnescah River humidity: Clearwater's position near the river creates ambient humidity conditions that accelerate moisture-related bathroom deterioration. Exhaust ventilation in Clearwater bathrooms needs to actually function — sized correctly and vented to exterior, not recirculating. We install fans rated for the room size and verify exterior venting.

Well-and-septic plumbing: Most Clearwater rural properties run on well and septic. We scope bathroom plumbing for well-water systems. Septic capacity checked before any fixture additions.

Older construction plumbing: 1950s–1970s Clearwater homes may have galvanized supply lines past their useful life. We assess during the consultation.

What We Build in Clearwater Bathrooms

  • Tile shower or tub surround — proper waterproofing membrane, porcelain tile
  • Vanity replacement with quality construction and quartz top
  • Plumbing updates where assessed as needed
  • Exhaust fan — properly sized and vented to exterior
  • Updated fixtures appropriate for well-water conditions

Permits in Clearwater

City of Clearwater Building Department for homes inside city limits. We handle all permits.

How We Approach Bathroom Remodeling in

Every bathroom remodel in starts with an in-person assessment. We walk the existing bathroom with you, look at what's behind the walls where it matters (around the tub/shower surround, under the vanity, at the subfloor where it meets the tub), and give you an honest read on what the project actually involves before any numbers get discussed.

We price in writing. Every line item - demo, plumbing, tile, vanity, fixtures, exhaust, permit - is documented before work starts. No surprises mid-project.

Our crew handles demo through final walkthrough. We don't hand off your project to a rotating cast of subcontractors who don't know each other's work. The people who pull the permits are the people who do the work and stand behind it.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas. If something isn't right at the final walkthrough, we fix it before we consider the project done.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Remodeling in Clearwater

How much does bathroom remodeling cost in Clearwater, KS?

Clearwater bathroom remodels range from $7,500 for a basic refresh to $24,000+ for a full primary bath renovation. Rural south Sedgwick County pricing. Written, line-item estimates.

Does the Ninnescah River location affect bathroom moisture in Clearwater?

It affects ambient humidity, which means exhaust ventilation needs to actually work. We size fans for the room and confirm they're vented to exterior. For homes where the existing exhaust has been inadequate for years, we also check the subfloor and wall cavity condition before closing new tile over existing moisture damage.

Who handles permits for bathroom remodeling in Clearwater?

City of Clearwater Building Department. We handle all permit applications and inspection scheduling.

My Clearwater home is on well and septic — does that affect bathroom remodeling?

For plumbing work, yes. We scope for well-water systems and check septic capacity before adding fixtures.

How long does a Clearwater bathroom remodel take?

2–4 weeks for most projects. Older homes with plumbing or subfloor work take toward the longer end.

Does bathroom remodeling add value in Clearwater?

Yes. South Sedgwick County has appreciated as the metro has grown southward. Updated bathrooms improve appraised value and marketability.
